# crosswork_smart_licensing_transport (Resource)

This resource can manage the Smart Licensing transport settings of the cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_smart_licensing_transport" "example" {
  mode       = "DIRECT"
  url        = "https://smartreceiver.cisco.com/licservice/license"
  proxy_host = "192.0.2.1"
  proxy_port = 8080
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `mode` (String) Transport mode, `DIRECT` (the Cisco licensing servers) or `ON_PREM` (an on-prem Smart Software Manager)
  - Choices: `DIRECT`, `ON_PREM`
  - Default value: `DIRECT`
- `proxy_host` (String) IP address or host name of the HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Only in `DIRECT` mode, and set together with `proxy_port`
- `proxy_port` (Number) Port of the HTTP or HTTPS proxy. Set together with `proxy_host`
  - Range: `1`-`65535`
- `url` (String) URL of the licensing server. The controller ignores it in `DIRECT` mode and keeps the Cisco URL, and requires the URL of the Smart Software Manager in `ON_PREM` mode
  - Default value: `https://smartreceiver.cisco.com/licservice/license`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_smart_licensing_transport.example "smart_licensing_transport"
```
